text:
ops-bot: INCIDENT detected — region=eu-west-1 | symptom=503 spikes across inference endpoints | autoscaler retry/fallbacks triggered. paging oncall.
oncall-alex: Ack. joining bridge now. seeing elevated error-rate in inference-proxy metrics (5xx ~ 18%).
maria: Confirmed. Autoscaler logs show several GPU nodes failed health checks around the same time — suspected node-level preemptions. Noticed rapid rollback attempts + pod churn.
kavi: On it. I'm running `kubectl get nodes -l gpu=true -o wide` and checking instance preemption traces.
eng-matt: Pushing a quick mitigation: enabling cross-region fallback for traffic to eu-central-1 to reduce pressure. Will toggle routing policy to prefer non-eu-west if latency delta < 200ms.
ryan: Noted. I'm upping burst-capacity for dedicated pools in eu-central while fallback routes stabilize.
oncall-alex: Mitigation steps applied: 1) routing change live 2) scaled dedicated pool +20% 3) disabled large-batch jobs targeting eu-west. Early signs: 5xx trending down from 18% -> 6%.
ops-bot: Post-mitigation alert: error-rate decreased but elevated latencies for fallthrough requests in eu-central (p50 +120ms). No customer-facing SLA breach recorded yet, but several tenants reported degraded experience.
zoe: Which customers reported issues? I have a traffic list for customers on eu-west. Need to notify those with critical SLAs.
maria: Quick scan: 3 enterprise customers (acct-A, acct-B, acct-C) saw increased error retries and some timeouts in logs between 11:36–11:50 UTC. Severity: acct-A maybe impacted for ~6m; acct-B retries handled funds-processing timeouts, flagged for follow-up.
kavi: Created ticket INFRA-8923 to track this incident and remediation (link: https://jira.redwood/INFRA-8923). Adding short-term and long-term action items there.
eng-matt: We also saw autoscaler metrics showing aggressive scale-down before preemption window; runbook might need tuning for node health thresholds. I'll add a diffs patch to the runbook.
oncall-alex: Putting together a short incident summary for customer ops and CS: timeframe, mitigation, customer list, next steps. Will ping cs-squad after this thread.
ryan: Action item: increase node-replacement grace period to 90s in autoscaler config — owner=ryan, due=2026-03-24 EOD.
maria: Action item: runbook update to include preemption-detection checklist and fallback verification steps — owner=maria, due=2026-03-25.
kavi: Action item: create canary test that simulates node preemption and validates cross-region routing — owner=kavi, due=2026-03-26.
zoe: Scheduling postmortem: propose 2026-03-24 15:00 UTC (30m). Invite list: eng-runtime, eng-sre, infra, product-ops, cs. Is that ok?
oncall-alex: Works for me.
eng-matt: Works. I'll prepare logs and a quick timeline (events, autoscaler decisions, node health events).
ops-bot: Reminder: please attach the following to INFRA-8923 before the postmortem: a) timeline b) grafana snapshots c) node health logs d) traffic reroute config diff.
maria: Quick note — we should consider a short-term guard: block large-batch low-priority jobs from draining into eu-west during autoscaler instability. I'll add that to the runbook patch.
ryan: Also propose an emergency fallback pool (pre-warmed small VMs) that can be spun up in <2m for critical customers — longer-term backlog.
zoe: CS: I'll send templated customer notifications to acct-A/B/C with incident summary + follow-up commitment. Will share drafts here for sign-off.
oncall-alex: Closing out active pager: system stable at 11:58 UTC, error-rate back to baseline. Keeping this thread open for remediation tracking and postmortem scheduling.
eng-matt: Postmortem agenda suggestion: 1) timeline & root cause hypothesis 2) mitigation effectiveness 3) runbook gaps 4) config changes and testing plan 5) owners & deadlines.
kavi: I'll own the preemption-simulation test plan and validate autoscaler tuning changes in staging. Adding notes to INFRA-8923.
ops-bot: Follow-up checklist added to INFRA-8923 by ops-bot: [ ] runbook update, [ ] autoscaler config bump, [ ] canary test, [ ] customer comms, [ ] backlog for emergency pool.
zoe: Draft customer note posted to INFRA-8923 comment. Please review and +1 for send.
maria: +1 on draft. Minor wording tweak on downtime windows.
ryan: +1
oncall-alex: Thanks everyone. Will mark incident as 'resolved' in PagerDuty and set the postmortem meeting invite. See you at the postmortem.
ops-bot: Incident resolved. Auto-tagging INFRA-8923, notifying stakeholders.
